title: Stage 8.15 Final Human Adjudication Audit
failure_summary: All 6 adjudication files failed the mandatory Human Rationale Quality Check (Section 3). Each file contains prohibited generic rationales ('I saw the fire on the image' / 'i saw the fire in the image') without chip-specific observable visual basis. Furthermore, all 6 files contain unaligned dummy/placeholder bounding box coordinates [200, 200, 300, 300] repeated multiple times.
